title: 3 PhD positions opening at QMUL in early 2027
text: I will be recruiting three PhD students in early 2027. PhD candidates should be interested/working on Internet measurement, standardisation, governance and/or economics. For examples of my work related to the analysis of standardisation processes, see my publications and the IRTF RASP Research Group. I am also open to intersting ideas outside of this scope. If you are interested, get in touch.
